_comment: Copy this file to 'catalog_config.json' next to AcmeScanner.exe to choose which catalog (analog) 'Update Catalog' downloads. Delete it (or set channel to 'production') to download the current running/production catalog (analog.zip). Staging downloads dev-analog.zip from the same VCR path and token. This only affects the catalog/analog download; the SDK and patch-status downloads are unaffected.
_analogFile_comment: Optional. An explicit file name overrides 'channel' if you need something other than analog.zip / dev-analog.zip.
